items.html: And the matter is that the order of the Atzilut of the Tifferet is below Hesed and Gevura; and through this coupling he inherits his father and mother, to ascend above Hesed and Gevura, in the secret of their root hidden in them — the crown that is called Hesed and the crown that is called Gevura; and he is found above them, and nurses from their roots hidden within the Tifferet, which he now inherits from his father and mother, and he inherits their place; and then he is called a free man, for he is not enslaved to Hesed and Gevura, but only to Aba and Ima, in his ascending above them. And the shells do not reach there, but freedom in the secret of the Jubilee.
